cap: Each lesion is named by where it sits. A polyp and a submucosal leiomyoma distort the cavity and cause bleeding; intramural and subserosal leiomyomas add bulk and pressure; adenomyosis scatters endometrium through the myometrium and makes the whole uterus globular; endometriosis puts glands and stroma outside the uterus, as a chocolate cyst on the ovary or as implants on the pelvic peritoneum.
